pairs: Respondens autem Dominus Job de turbine,
But the Lord, answering Job out of the whirlwind,
Gird your waist like a man.
Will you make my judgment null
and will you condemn me so that you may be justified?
Et si habes brachium sicut Deus?
And do you have an arm like God,
and raise yourself up on high,
Scatter the arrogant with your wrath,
and, when you see all the arrogant, humble them.
Look down upon each of the arrogant
et contere impios in loco suo.
and crush the impious in their place.
Hide them in the dust together
et facies eorum demerge in foveam.
and plunge their faces into the pit.
Et ego confitebor quod salvare te possit dextera tua.
Then I will confess that your right hand is able to save you.
Behold, the behemoth, whom I created along with you,
His strength is in his lower back,
et virtus illius in umbilico ventris ejus.
and his power is in the center of his abdomen.
He draws up his tail like a cedar;
the sinews of his thighs have been drawn together.
His bones are like pipes of brass;
his cartilage is like plates of iron.
He is the beginning of the ways of God,
qui fecit eum applicabit gladium ejus.
who made him; he will use him as his sword.
The mountains bring forth grass for him;
all the beasts of the field will play there.
Sub umbra dormit in secreto calami,
He sleeps in the shadows, under the cover of branches,
the willows of the brook will encircle him.
he will drink a river and not be amazed,
et habet fiduciam quod influat Jordanis in os ejus.
and he has confidence that the Jordan could flow into his mouth.
In oculis ejus quasi hamo capiet eum,
He will seize him through his eyes, as if with a hook,
et in sudibus perforabit nares ejus.
and he will bore through his nostrils, as if with stakes.
Can you draw out the leviathan with a hook,
and can you bind his tongue with a cord?
Numquid pones circulum in naribus ejus,
Can you place a ring in his nose,
or bore through his jaw with an arm band?
Will he offer many prayers to you,
Will he form a covenant with you,
and will you accept him as a servant forever?
Will you play with him as with a bird,
or tether him for your handmaids?
Will your friends cut him into pieces,
Will you fill up bags with his hide,
and let his head be used as a home for fishes?
Behold, his hope will fail him,
and in the sight of all, he will be thrown down.
